    Uploading it manually

    On :

    1. Create a new repository.

    2. Open the repository.

    3. Choose Add file → Upload files.

    index.html

    Routine 03 — VERIFY ARCHIVE
    #!/usr/bin/env bash

# ============================================================
# 03_VERIFY_ARCHIVE.sh
#
# PURPOSE:
#   Verify that the temporary archive is an exact usable copy
#   of the session received from the GitHub thumb drive.
#
# THIS ROUTINE:
#   - READS the thumb-drive session
#   - READS the temporary archive
#   - COMPARES their complete contents
#   - DOES NOT modify either location
#   - Returns SUCCESS (0) or FAILURE (non-zero)
#
# SUCCESS MEANS:
#   The archive is verified and may be used for processing.
#
# FAILURE MEANS:
#   The Hub stops immediately.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

THUMB_DRIVE="/d/GitHub"

TEMP_ARCHIVE="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Session_Archive"


# ============================================================
# 03A — LOCATE THE SESSION ON THE THUMB DRIVE
# ============================================================

SESSION_FOLDER=""

for ITEM in "$THUMB_DRIVE"/*; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    SESSION_FOLDER="$ITEM"
    break

done


if [ -z "$SESSION_FOLDER" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Session folder no longer exists on thumb drive."
    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 03B — DETERMINE SESSION NAME
# ============================================================

SESSION_NAME="$(basename "$SESSION_FOLDER")"

ARCHIVE_FOLDER="$TEMP_ARCHIVE/$SESSION_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 03C — VERIFY ARCHIVE EXISTS
# ============================================================

if [ ! -d "$ARCHIVE_FOLDER" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Archived session does not exist."
    echo "       Expected:"
    echo "       $ARCHIVE_FOLDER"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Archived session found."


# ============================================================
# 03D — COMPARE COMPLETE DIRECTORY CONTENTS
#
# diff -r recursively examines the entire directory tree.
#
# Any missing, extra, or different file causes failure.
# ============================================================

echo "[WORKING] Comparing original and archive..."


diff -rq "$SESSION_FOLDER" "$ARCHIVE_FOLDER"

DIFF_RESULT=$?


if [ "$DIFF_RESULT" -ne 0 ]; then

    echo
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
    echo "[FAIL] ARCHIVE VERIFICATION FAILED"
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
    echo "The temporary archive does not exactly match"
    echo "the session on the thumb drive."
    echo
    echo "The session will remain on the thumb drive."
    echo "The Hub will stop."
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 03E — EXPLICIT EDGE PAIR CHECK
#
# The recursive comparison above verifies everything.
# We additionally confirm the two critical Edge components.
# ============================================================

HTML_COUNT=0
FILES_FOLDER_COUNT=0


for ITEM in "$ARCHIVE_FOLDER"/*.html "$ARCHIVE_FOLDER"/*.htm; do

    [ -f "$ITEM" ] || continue

    HTML_COUNT=$((HTML_COUNT + 1))

done


for ITEM in "$ARCHIVE_FOLDER"/*_files; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    FILES_FOLDER_COUNT=$((FILES_FOLDER_COUNT + 1))

done


if [ "$HTML_COUNT" -ne 1 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Archive does not contain exactly one HTML file."
    exit 1

fi


if [ "$FILES_FOLDER_COUNT" -ne 1 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Archive does not contain exactly one *_files folder."
    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 03F — SUCCESS
# ============================================================

echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "[SUCCESS] ARCHIVE VERIFIED"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "The temporary archive matches the thumb-drive session."
echo
echo "The Edge HTML + _files pair is present."
echo
echo "The archive is now trusted for processing."
echo "============================================================"


# ============================================================
# RETURN SUCCESS TO HUB
# ============================================================

exit 0

    Routine 04 — PREPARE WEB
    #!/usr/bin/env bash

# ============================================================
# 04_PREPARE_WEB.sh
#
# PURPOSE:
#   Create the webpage-publishing copy from the verified
#   temporary archive.
#
#   The original Edge capture remains untouched.
#
# THIS ROUTINE:
#   - READS the verified temporary archive
#   - CREATES a separate publishing copy
#   - RENAMES ONLY the HTML COPY to index.html
#   - PRESERVES the original *_files folder name
#   - DOES NOT modify the thumb drive
#   - DOES NOT modify the Library repository
#   - DOES NOT upload anything
#   - Returns SUCCESS (0) or FAILURE (non-zero)
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   The HTML file's references to the *_files folder must
#   remain valid after the HTML copy is renamed.
#   Routine 04 therefore verifies those references before
#   declaring success.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

TEMP_ARCHIVE="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Session_Archive"

WEB_WORK="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Web_Work"


# ============================================================
# 04A — LOCATE THE SINGLE ARCHIVED SESSION
# ============================================================

SESSION_FOLDER=""

for ITEM in "$TEMP_ARCHIVE"/*; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    SESSION_FOLDER="$ITEM"
    break

done


if [ -z "$SESSION_FOLDER" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] No archived session found."
    exit 1

fi


SESSION_NAME="$(basename "$SESSION_FOLDER")"

echo "[OK] Archived session located:"
echo "     $SESSION_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 04B — CREATE WEB WORK AREA
# ============================================================

if [ -e "$WEB_WORK/$SESSION_NAME" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] A web work copy already exists for:"
    echo "       $SESSION_NAME"
    echo
    echo "No existing web work was overwritten."

    exit 1

fi


mkdir -p "$WEB_WORK"

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not create web work directory."
    exit 1

fi


WEB_FOLDER="$WEB_WORK/$SESSION_NAME"

mkdir -p "$WEB_FOLDER"

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not create session web directory."
    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 04C — LOCATE THE ORIGINAL EDGE HTML
# ============================================================

HTML_FILE=""

for ITEM in "$SESSION_FOLDER"/*.html "$SESSION_FOLDER"/*.htm; do

    [ -f "$ITEM" ] || continue

    HTML_FILE="$ITEM"
    break

done


if [ -z "$HTML_FILE" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] No HTML file found in archived session."
    rm -rf "$WEB_FOLDER"
    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 04D — LOCATE THE EDGE _files FOLDER
# ============================================================

FILES_FOLDER=""

for ITEM in "$SESSION_FOLDER"/*_files; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    FILES_FOLDER="$ITEM"
    break

done


if [ -z "$FILES_FOLDER" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] No *_files folder found in archived session."
    rm -rf "$WEB_FOLDER"
    exit 1

fi


FILES_NAME="$(basename "$FILES_FOLDER")"


# ============================================================
# 04E — COPY THE EDGE _files FOLDER
#
# This is copied without changing its name.
# ============================================================

echo "[WORKING] Copying Edge _files folder..."

cp -R "$FILES_FOLDER" "$WEB_FOLDER/$FILES_NAME"

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not copy the *_files folder."
    rm -rf "$WEB_FOLDER"
    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 04F — CREATE index.html
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   We COPY the original HTML.
#   We do NOT rename or alter the original.
# ============================================================

echo "[WORKING] Creating index.html..."

cp "$HTML_FILE" "$WEB_FOLDER/index.html"

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not create index.html."
    rm -rf "$WEB_FOLDER"
    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 04G — VERIFY THE PUBLISHING PAIR EXISTS
# ============================================================

if [ ! -f "$WEB_FOLDER/index.html" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] index.html was not created."
    rm -rf "$WEB_FOLDER"
    exit 1

fi


if [ ! -d "$WEB_FOLDER/$FILES_NAME" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] *_files folder was not copied."
    rm -rf "$WEB_FOLDER"
    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 04H — VERIFY HTML REFERENCES
#
# The HTML may contain references such as:
#
#     OriginalName_files/image.png
#
# Renaming the HTML itself does not automatically rewrite
# those references.
#
# We therefore check that references to the Edge resource
# folder still point to files that exist.
#
# The detailed resource verification will remain available
# to later webpage verification routines as well.
# ============================================================

if grep -q "${FILES_NAME}/" "$WEB_FOLDER/index.html"; then

    echo "[OK] HTML contains references to:"
    echo "     $FILES_NAME"

else

    echo "[WARNING] No direct reference to $FILES_NAME was found."
    echo "          The HTML may use another resource structure."
    echo "          Processing is stopped for safety."

    rm -rf "$WEB_FOLDER"
    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 04I — FINAL REPORT
# ============================================================

echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "[SUCCESS] WEB PUBLISHING COPY PREPARED"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "Original Edge capture:"
echo "  $SESSION_FOLDER"
echo
echo "Publishing directory:"
echo "  $WEB_FOLDER"
echo
echo "Publishing HTML:"
echo "  index.html"
echo
echo "Resource folder:"
echo "  $FILES_NAME"
echo
echo "ORIGINAL EDGE FILES WERE NOT MODIFIED."
echo "============================================================"


# ============================================================
# RETURN SUCCESS TO HUB
# ============================================================

exit 0

    Routine 05 — PUSH LIBRARY
    #!/usr/bin/env bash

# ============================================================
# 05_PUSH_LIBRARY.sh
#
# PURPOSE:
#   Push the ORIGINAL, UNALTERED Edge session from the
#   temporary archive into the Library GitHub repository.
#
# THIS ROUTINE:
#   - READS the temporary archive
#   - COPIES the original Edge session into the local
#     Library repository
#   - COMMITS the new session
#   - PUSHES the commit to GitHub
#   - DOES NOT modify the original thumb-drive session
#   - DOES NOT modify the Web repository
#   - DOES NOT delete anything
#   - Returns SUCCESS (0) or FAILURE (non-zero)
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   The Library receives the original Edge pair.
#   It does NOT receive index.html.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

TEMP_ARCHIVE="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Session_Archive"

# The local folder containing the cloned Library repository.
# THIS PATH WILL BE SET WHEN WE INSTALL THE SYSTEM.

LIBRARY_REPO="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Library"


# ============================================================
# 05A — LOCATE THE SINGLE ARCHIVED SESSION
# ============================================================

SESSION_FOLDER=""

for ITEM in "$TEMP_ARCHIVE"/*; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    SESSION_FOLDER="$ITEM"
    break

done


if [ -z "$SESSION_FOLDER" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] No archived session found."
    exit 1

fi


SESSION_NAME="$(basename "$SESSION_FOLDER")"

echo "[OK] Archived session found:"
echo "     $SESSION_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 05B — VERIFY LIBRARY REPOSITORY EXISTS
# ============================================================

if [ ! -d "$LIBRARY_REPO" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Local Library repository was not found."
    echo "       Expected:"
    echo "       $LIBRARY_REPO"

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 05C — VERIFY IT REALLY IS A GIT REPOSITORY
# ============================================================

if [ ! -d "$LIBRARY_REPO/.git" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Library location is not a Git repository."
    echo "       $LIBRARY_REPO"

    exit 1

fi

echo "[OK] Library Git repository found."


# ============================================================
# 05D — CHECK FOR AN EXISTING SESSION
#
# We NEVER overwrite an existing Library episode.
# If the same episode name already exists, stop and let the
# human decide what should happen.
# ============================================================

LIBRARY_DESTINATION="$LIBRARY_REPO/$SESSION_NAME"

if [ -e "$LIBRARY_DESTINATION" ]; then

    echo
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
    echo "[FAIL] This session already exists in the Library."
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
    echo "$LIBRARY_DESTINATION"
    echo
    echo "Nothing was overwritten."
    echo "The Hub will stop."
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 05E — COPY THE ORIGINAL SESSION
#
# The archive contains the untouched Edge-created pair:
#
#     OriginalName.html
#     OriginalName_files/
#
# We copy the complete episode folder exactly as it exists.
# ============================================================

echo "[WORKING] Copying original session into Library..."

cp -R "$SESSION_FOLDER" "$LIBRARY_DESTINATION"

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not copy session into Library repository."

    # Remove a possibly incomplete copy.
    rm -rf "$LIBRARY_DESTINATION"

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 05F — BASIC COPY CHECK
# ============================================================

if [ ! -d "$LIBRARY_DESTINATION" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Library destination was not created."

    exit 1

fi

echo "[OK] Original session copied into Library repository."


# ============================================================
# 05G — REVIEW GIT STATUS
# ============================================================

cd "$LIBRARY_REPO" || {

    echo "[FAIL] Could not enter Library repository."

    exit 1

}


echo
echo "[WORKING] Checking Git status..."

git status --short


# ============================================================
# 05H — ADD ONLY THIS SESSION
#
# We deliberately add the session directory rather than
# blindly using "git add ." so that this transaction cannot
# accidentally scoop up unrelated files sitting in the
# repository.
# ============================================================

git add -- "$SESSION_NAME"

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Git could not stage the session."

    exit 1

fi

echo "[OK] Session staged for Library commit."


# ============================================================
# 05I — VERIFY SOMETHING WAS ACTUALLY STAGED
# ============================================================

if git diff --cached --quiet; then

    echo "[FAIL] Git reports no staged changes."

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 05J — CREATE COMMIT
# ============================================================

COMMIT_MESSAGE="Add $SESSION_NAME"

echo "[WORKING] Creating Library commit..."

git commit -m "$COMMIT_MESSAGE"

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Git commit failed."

    exit 1

fi

echo "[OK] Library commit created."


# ============================================================
# 05K — PUSH TO GITHUB
# ============================================================

echo "[WORKING] Pushing Library commit to GitHub..."

git push

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
    echo "[FAIL] Library push failed."
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
    echo "The session remains in the temporary archive."
    echo "The session remains on the thumb drive."
    echo "The Hub will stop."
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 05L — SUCCESS
#
# Routine 06 will independently verify the result on GitHub.
# ============================================================

echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "[SUCCESS] LIBRARY PUSH COMPLETED"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "Session:"
echo "  $SESSION_NAME"
echo
echo "The original Edge session was pushed to the Library."
echo
echo "Routine 06 will now verify the Library."
echo "============================================================"


# ============================================================
# RETURN SUCCESS TO HUB
# ============================================================

exit 0

    Routine 06 — VERIFY LIBRARY
    #!/usr/bin/env bash

# ============================================================
# 06_VERIFY_LIBRARY.sh
#
# PURPOSE:
#   Independently verify that the Library session pushed by
#   Routine 05 actually exists in the GitHub repository.
#
# THIS ROUTINE:
#   - READS the local Library repository
#   - CONTACTS the GitHub remote
#   - VERIFIES that the remote branch points to the commit
#     we just created
#   - VERIFIES that the expected session exists in that
#     remote commit
#   - DOES NOT modify the thumb drive
#   - DOES NOT delete anything
#   - Returns SUCCESS (0) or FAILURE (non-zero)
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   A successful "git push" is NOT considered sufficient.
#   This routine independently verifies the remote result.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

TEMP_ARCHIVE="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Session_Archive"

LIBRARY_REPO="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Library"

LIBRARY_BRANCH="main"


# ============================================================
# 06A — LOCATE THE ARCHIVED SESSION
# ============================================================

SESSION_FOLDER=""

for ITEM in "$TEMP_ARCHIVE"/*; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    SESSION_FOLDER="$ITEM"
    break

done


if [ -z "$SESSION_FOLDER" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] No archived session found."
    exit 1

fi


SESSION_NAME="$(basename "$SESSION_FOLDER")"

echo "[OK] Archived session identified:"
echo "     $SESSION_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 06B — VERIFY LOCAL LIBRARY REPOSITORY
# ============================================================

if [ ! -d "$LIBRARY_REPO/.git" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Local Library repository not found."
    exit 1

fi


cd "$LIBRARY_REPO" || {

    echo "[FAIL] Could not enter Library repository."
    exit 1

}

echo "[OK] Local Library repository available."


# ============================================================
# 06C — IDENTIFY THE LOCAL COMMIT THAT WAS PUSHED
# ============================================================

LOCAL_COMMIT="$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)"

if [ -z "$LOCAL_COMMIT" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not determine local Library commit."
    exit 1

fi

echo "[OK] Local commit identified:"
echo "     $LOCAL_COMMIT"


# ============================================================
# 06D — CONTACT THE GITHUB REMOTE
#
# git fetch does not alter the working files.
# It updates Git's knowledge of the remote repository.
# ============================================================

echo "[WORKING] Contacting Library GitHub repository..."

git fetch origin "$LIBRARY_BRANCH"

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not contact Library GitHub repository."
    exit 1

fi

echo "[OK] GitHub remote contacted."


# ============================================================
# 06E — DETERMINE REMOTE COMMIT
# ============================================================

REMOTE_COMMIT="$(git rev-parse "origin/$LIBRARY_BRANCH" 2>/dev/null)"

if [ -z "$REMOTE_COMMIT" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not determine remote Library commit."
    exit 1

fi

echo "[OK] Remote commit identified:"
echo "     $REMOTE_COMMIT"


# ============================================================
# 06F — COMPARE LOCAL AND REMOTE COMMITS
#
# If they match, GitHub's remote branch is pointing to the
# exact commit that exists locally after our push.
# ============================================================

if [ "$LOCAL_COMMIT" != "$REMOTE_COMMIT" ]; then

    echo
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
    echo "[FAIL] LOCAL AND REMOTE COMMITS DO NOT MATCH"
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
    echo
    echo "Local:"
    echo "  $LOCAL_COMMIT"
    echo
    echo "Remote:"
    echo "  $REMOTE_COMMIT"
    echo
    echo "The Library upload cannot be considered verified."
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"

    exit 1

fi

echo "[OK] GitHub remote matches the pushed commit."


# ============================================================
# 06G — VERIFY SESSION DIRECTORY EXISTS IN REMOTE COMMIT
#
# git ls-tree examines the actual Git tree represented by
# the remote commit.
#
# We are not merely checking the local computer.
# ============================================================

echo "[WORKING] Checking session in remote Library tree..."

REMOTE_SESSION_COUNT=$(
    git ls-tree -r --name-only "origin/$LIBRARY_BRANCH" -- "$SESSION_NAME/" \
    | grep -c .
)


if [ "$REMOTE_SESSION_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then

    echo
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
    echo "[FAIL] Session was not found in the remote Library."
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
    exit 1

fi

echo "[OK] Session exists in remote Library tree."


# ============================================================
# 06H — VERIFY HTML FILE EXISTS
# ============================================================

REMOTE_HTML_COUNT=$(
    git ls-tree -r --name-only "origin/$LIBRARY_BRANCH" -- "$SESSION_NAME/" \
    | grep -Ei '\.(html|htm)$' \
    | grep -c .
)


if [ "$REMOTE_HTML_COUNT" -ne 1 ]; then

    echo
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
    echo "[FAIL] Expected exactly one HTML file in remote Library."
    echo "[FAIL] Found: $REMOTE_HTML_COUNT"
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"

    exit 1

fi

echo "[OK] Original HTML file exists in remote Library."


# ============================================================
# 06I — VERIFY _files FOLDER CONTENT EXISTS
# ============================================================

REMOTE_FILES_COUNT=$(
    git ls-tree -r --name-only "origin/$LIBRARY_BRANCH" -- "$SESSION_NAME/" \
    | grep -E '_files/' \
    | grep -c .
)


if [ "$REMOTE_FILES_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then

    echo
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
    echo "[FAIL] No *_files contents found in remote Library."
    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"

    exit 1

fi

echo "[OK] _files contents exist in remote Library."


# ============================================================
# 06J — FINAL REPORT
# ============================================================

echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "[SUCCESS] LIBRARY VERIFIED ON GITHUB"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "Session:"
echo "  $SESSION_NAME"
echo
echo "Remote commit:"
echo "  $REMOTE_COMMIT"
echo
echo "Verified:"
echo "  [OK] Remote commit"
echo "  [OK] Session directory"
echo "  [OK] Original HTML"
echo "  [OK] _files contents"
echo
echo "The original Edge session is confirmed in the Library."
echo "============================================================"


# ============================================================
# RETURN SUCCESS TO HUB
# ============================================================

exit 0

#   - COPIES it into the local Web repository
#   - COMMITS the webpage

# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

WEB_WORK="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Web_Work"

WEB_REPO="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Web"

WEB_BRANCH="main"

# 07A — LOCATE THE PREPARED WEB SESSION
# ============================================================

WEB_SESSION=""

for ITEM in "$WEB_WORK"/*; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    WEB_SESSION="$ITEM"
    break

done


if [ -z "$WEB_SESSION" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] No prepared webpage session was found."
    exit 1

fi


SESSION_NAME="$(basename "$WEB_SESSION")"

echo "[OK] Prepared webpage found:"
echo "     $SESSION_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 07B — VERIFY WEB REPOSITORY EXISTS
# ============================================================

if [ ! -d "$WEB_REPO" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Local Web repository was not found."
    echo "       Expected:"
    echo "       $WEB_REPO"

    exit 1

fi


if [ ! -d "$WEB_REPO/.git" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Web location is not a Git repository."

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Web Git repository found."


# ============================================================
# 07C — VERIFY index.html EXISTS
# ============================================================

if [ ! -f "$WEB_SESSION/index.html" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Prepared webpage does not contain index.html."
    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 07D — LOCATE _files FOLDER
# ============================================================

FILES_FOLDER=""

for ITEM in "$WEB_SESSION"/*_files; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    FILES_FOLDER="$ITEM"
    break

done


if [ -z "$FILES_FOLDER" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Prepared webpage does not contain a *_files folder."
    exit 1

fi


FILES_NAME="$(basename "$FILES_FOLDER")"

echo "[OK] index.html found."

#

# ============================================================

if [ -e "$WEB_DESTINATION" ]; then

    echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
    echo "$WEB_DESTINATION"

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    rm -rf "$WEB_DESTINATION"

    exit 1

fi

# 07H — VERIFY LOCAL WEB COPY
# ============================================================

if [ ! -f "$WEB_DESTINATION/index.html" ]; then

    rm -rf "$WEB_DESTINATION"

    exit 1

fi


if [ ! -d "$WEB_DESTINATION/$FILES_NAME" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] *_files folder is missing from Web repository copy."

    rm -rf "$WEB_DESTINATION"

fi


echo "[OK] Webpage copied into local Web repository."


# ============================================================
# 07I — ENTER WEB REPOSITORY
# ============================================================

cd "$WEB_REPO" || {

    echo "[FAIL] Could not enter Web repository."

    exit 1

}


# ============================================================

# ============================================================

echo "[WORKING] Staging webpage..."

git add -- "$SESSION_NAME"

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

git push origin "$WEB_BRANCH"

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

echo

echo
echo "Session:"

echo
echo "Web files pushed:"

echo
echo "Routine 08 will now verify the Web files."

# ============================================================

#
# THIS ROUTINE:
#   - READS the prepared Web work copy
#   - CONTACTS the Web repository remote
#   - VERIFIES that the remote branch contains the pushed commit
#   - VERIFIES that index.html exists remotely
#   - VERIFIES that the Edge *_files folder contains files
#   - DOES NOT modify the thumb drive
#   - DOES NOT delete anything
#   - Returns SUCCESS (0) or FAILURE (non-zero)
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   A successful "git push" is NOT considered sufficient.
#   This routine independently examines the remote repository.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

WEB_WORK="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Web_Work"

WEB_REPO="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Web"

WEB_BRANCH="main"


# ============================================================
# 08A — LOCATE PREPARED WEB SESSION
# ============================================================

WEB_SESSION=""

for ITEM in "$WEB_WORK"/*; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    WEB_SESSION="$ITEM"
    break

done


if [ -z "$WEB_SESSION" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] No prepared webpage session found."
    exit 1

fi


SESSION_NAME="$(basename "$WEB_SESSION")"

echo "[OK] Prepared webpage identified:"
echo "     $SESSION_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 08B — VERIFY LOCAL WEB REPOSITORY
# ============================================================

if [ ! -d "$WEB_REPO/.git" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Local Web repository was not found."
    exit 1

fi


cd "$WEB_REPO" || {

    echo "[FAIL] Could not enter Web repository."
    exit 1

}


echo "[OK] Local Web repository available."


# ============================================================
# 08C — IDENTIFY LOCAL COMMIT
# ============================================================

LOCAL_COMMIT="$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)"

if [ -z "$LOCAL_COMMIT" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not determine local Web commit."
    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Local Web commit identified:"
echo "     $LOCAL_COMMIT"


# ============================================================
# 08D — CONTACT GITHUB
# ============================================================

echo "[WORKING] Contacting Web GitHub repository..."

git fetch origin "$WEB_BRANCH"

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] GitHub Web repository contacted."


# ============================================================
# 08E — DETERMINE REMOTE COMMIT
# ============================================================

REMOTE_COMMIT="$(git rev-parse "origin/$WEB_BRANCH" 2>/dev/null)"

if [ -z "$REMOTE_COMMIT" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not determine remote Web commit."
    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Remote Web commit identified:"
echo "     $REMOTE_COMMIT"


# ============================================================
# 08F — COMPARE COMMITS

if [ "$LOCAL_COMMIT" != "$REMOTE_COMMIT" ]; then

if [ "$REMOTE_SESSION_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then

fi


echo "[OK] Web session exists remotely."

exit 0

    Routine 09 — VERIFY WEBPAGE
    #!/usr/bin/env bash

# ============================================================
# 09_VERIFY_WEBPAGE.sh
#
# PURPOSE:
#   Verify that the webpage created by GitHub Pages can
#   actually be reached through its public web address.
#
# THIS ROUTINE:
#   - CONTACTS the published GitHub Pages website
#   - WAITS for publication if necessary
#   - RETRIES several times
#   - DOES NOT modify GitHub
#   - DOES NOT modify the thumb drive
#   - DOES NOT delete anything
#   - Returns SUCCESS (0) or FAILURE (non-zero)
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   Routine 08 verified that the files exist in GitHub.
#
#   Routine 09 verifies that those files have actually
#   become a reachable webpage.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

# The base address of the GitHub Pages website.
#
# THIS WILL BE SET WHEN WE CONFIGURE THE ACTUAL ACCOUNT.
#
# Example:
#
#   https://USERNAME.github.io/REPOSITORY
#
# Do NOT put the episode path here.

PAGES_BASE_URL="https://YOUR-USERNAME.github.io/YOUR-WEB-REPOSITORY"


# Maximum number of attempts.
MAX_ATTEMPTS=12


# Seconds between attempts.
WAIT_SECONDS=10


# ============================================================
# 09A — LOCATE THE PREPARED SESSION
# ============================================================

WEB_WORK="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Web_Work"

WEB_SESSION=""

for ITEM in "$WEB_WORK"/*; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    WEB_SESSION="$ITEM"
    break

done


if [ -z "$WEB_SESSION" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] No prepared webpage session found."
    exit 1

fi


SESSION_NAME="$(basename "$WEB_SESSION")"

echo "[OK] Prepared webpage identified:"
echo "     $SESSION_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 09B — BUILD THE PAGE ADDRESS
#
# The webpage directory contains:
#
#     index.html
#
# Therefore the directory URL is the webpage address.
#
# Example:
#
#     https://username.github.io/repository/
#         Project-Episode/
#
# The exact directory structure will be finalized when
# the repository naming scheme is installed.
# ============================================================

PAGE_URL="${PAGES_BASE_URL}/${SESSION_NAME}/"


echo
echo "[OK] Webpage address:"
echo "     $PAGE_URL"


# ============================================================
# 09C — VERIFY CURL IS AVAILABLE
# ============================================================

if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then

    echo "[FAIL] curl is not available in Git Bash."
    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Web connection utility available."


# ============================================================
# 09D — WAIT FOR GITHUB PAGES
#
# GitHub Pages may require some time after the Git push.
#
# We therefore retry instead of treating the first
# unsuccessful request as a failure.
# ============================================================

ATTEMPT=1

while [ "$ATTEMPT" -le "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do

    echo
    echo "[WORKING] Checking published webpage."
    echo "          Attempt $ATTEMPT of $MAX_ATTEMPTS"

    HTTP_STATUS="$(
        curl \
            --silent \
            --show-error \
            --output /dev/null \
            --write-out "%{http_code}" \
            --location \
            --max-time 20 \
            "$PAGE_URL"
    )"

    CURL_RESULT=$?


    # ========================================================
    # 09E — CHECK CONNECTION RESULT
    # ========================================================

    if [ "$CURL_RESULT" -eq 0 ]; then

        echo "[OK] Web server responded."
        echo "     HTTP status: $HTTP_STATUS"


        # ====================================================
        # 09F — ACCEPT A SUCCESSFUL HTTP RESPONSE
        # ====================================================

        if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -ge 200 ] &&
           [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -lt 400 ]; then

            echo
            echo "============================================================"
            echo "[SUCCESS] PUBLISHED WEBPAGE VERIFIED"
            echo "============================================================"
            echo
            echo "Session:"
            echo "  $SESSION_NAME"
            echo
            echo "Published webpage:"
            echo "  $PAGE_URL"
            echo
            echo "The webpage is responding through GitHub Pages."
            echo "============================================================"

            exit 0

        fi

    else

        echo "[WAIT] Could not yet retrieve the webpage."

    fi


    # ========================================================
    # 09G — RETRY
    # ========================================================

    if [ "$ATTEMPT" -lt "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then

        echo "[WAIT] GitHub Pages may still be publishing."
        echo "       Waiting $WAIT_SECONDS seconds..."

        sleep "$WAIT_SECONDS"

    fi


    ATTEMPT=$((ATTEMPT + 1))

done


# ============================================================
# 09H — FINAL FAILURE
# ============================================================

echo
echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
echo "[FAIL] PUBLISHED WEBPAGE COULD NOT BE VERIFIED"
echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
echo
echo "The Web repository contains the files, but the actual"
echo "published webpage did not respond successfully."
echo
echo "The session remains:"
echo "  - on the thumb drive"
echo "  - in the temporary archive"
echo
echo "The Hub will stop."
echo "------------------------------------------------------------"


# ============================================================
# RETURN FAILURE TO HUB
# ============================================================

exit 1

#   - COMMITS the catalog change

#   - DOES NOT modify the original Edge capture

#   - Returns SUCCESS (0) or FAILURE (non-zero)
# ============================================================

# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

LIBRARY_REPO="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Library"

LIBRARY_BRANCH="main"

LIBRARY_CATALOG="$LIBRARY_REPO/README.md"

# 10A — LOCATE THE SESSION
# ============================================================

SESSION_FOLDER=""

for ITEM in "$TEMP_ARCHIVE"/*; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    SESSION_FOLDER="$ITEM"
    break

done


if [ -z "$SESSION_FOLDER" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] No archived session found."
    exit 1

fi


SESSION_NAME="$(basename "$SESSION_FOLDER")"

echo "[OK] Session identified:"
echo "     $SESSION_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 10B — VERIFY LIBRARY REPOSITORY
# ============================================================

if [ ! -d "$LIBRARY_REPO/.git" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Library repository was not found."
    exit 1

    exit 1

}

# ============================================================

#
# The exact Pages base address will be configured when the
# actual Web repository is established.

PAGES_BASE_URL="https://YOUR-USERNAME.github.io/YOUR-WEB-REPOSITORY"

PAGE_URL="${PAGES_BASE_URL}/${SESSION_NAME}/"

# 10E — CHECK WHETHER THIS LINK ALREADY EXISTS
#
# Never create duplicate catalog entries.

if grep -Fq "$PAGE_URL" "$LIBRARY_CATALOG"; then

    echo "[FAIL] This webpage link already exists in the Library."

# ============================================================

echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "Episode:"
echo "  $SESSION_NAME"
echo
echo "Read Episode:"
echo "  $PAGE_URL"

echo "Routine 11 will now verify the Library link."

echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "[SUCCESS] LIBRARY LINK VERIFIED"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "Episode:"

echo
echo "Link:"
echo "  $PAGE_URL"
echo
echo "Verified against the remote GitHub Library catalog."
echo
echo "The Library now points to the verified webpage."
echo "============================================================"


# ============================================================

exit 0

    Routine 02 — Archive Session

    This routine makes the temporary safety copy. It also makes sure the archive is empty before we put this session into it, which prevents old material from contaminating the transaction.

    Routine 02 — Archive Session
    #!/usr/bin/env bash

# ============================================================
# 02_ARCHIVE_SESSION.sh
#
# PURPOSE:
#   Copy the ONE verified session from the thumb drive into
#   the temporary Kiosk archive.
#
# INPUT:
#   SESSION_NAME
#   supplied by the Hub after Routine 01.
#
# THIS ROUTINE:
#   - Confirms the identified session still exists
#   - Confirms the temporary archive exists
#   - Confirms the archive contains no old sessions
#   - Copies the session into the archive
#   - Verifies the copy exists
#   - DOES NOT delete the thumb-drive original
#
# RETURN:
#   0 = SUCCESS
#   non-zero = FAILURE
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

THUMB_DRIVE="/d/GitHub"

TEMP_ARCHIVE="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Session_Archive"


# ============================================================
# 02A — REQUIRE SESSION NAME
#
# The Hub supplies SESSION_NAME.
# ============================================================

if [ -z "$SESSION_NAME" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] SESSION_NAME was not supplied by the Hub."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Hub supplied session:"
echo "     $SESSION_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 02B — VERIFY ORIGINAL SESSION
# ============================================================

SOURCE_SESSION="$THUMB_DRIVE/$SESSION_NAME"


if [ ! -d "$SOURCE_SESSION" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] The identified session is no longer on the thumb drive."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Original session is still present."


# ============================================================
# 02C — CREATE TEMPORARY ARCHIVE IF NECESSARY
# ============================================================

if [ ! -d "$TEMP_ARCHIVE" ]; then

    echo "[WORKING] Creating temporary archive..."

    mkdir -p "$TEMP_ARCHIVE"

    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

        echo "[FAIL] Could not create temporary archive."

        exit 1

    fi

fi


echo "[OK] Temporary archive is available."


# ============================================================
# 02D — VERIFY ARCHIVE IS EMPTY
#
# This is important.
#
# We are deliberately operating one session at a time.
# Therefore an old session in the archive is not harmless:
# it could cause later routines to confuse the old session
# with the current transaction.
# ============================================================

ARCHIVE_ITEM_COUNT=0


for ITEM in "$TEMP_ARCHIVE"/*; do

    [ -e "$ITEM" ] || continue

    ARCHIVE_ITEM_COUNT=$((ARCHIVE_ITEM_COUNT + 1))

done


if [ "$ARCHIVE_ITEM_COUNT" -ne 0 ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Temporary archive is not empty."
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "Items found: $ARCHIVE_ITEM_COUNT"
    echo
    echo "The Kiosk will NOT guess which material belongs to this"
    echo "transaction."
    echo
    echo "Nothing has been copied."
    echo "Nothing has been deleted."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Temporary archive is empty."


# ============================================================
# 02E — COPY SESSION
# ============================================================

DESTINATION="$TEMP_ARCHIVE/$SESSION_NAME"


echo
echo "[WORKING] Creating temporary safety copy..."
echo
echo "From:"
echo "  $SOURCE_SESSION"
echo
echo "To:"
echo "  $DESTINATION"


cp -R "$SOURCE_SESSION" "$DESTINATION"


if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Session could not be copied to the archive."
    echo "============================================================"

    # If a partial destination was created, remove only that
    # incomplete copy. The original remains untouched.

    if [ -e "$DESTINATION" ]; then

        rm -rf -- "$DESTINATION"

    fi

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 02F — VERIFY ARCHIVED SESSION
# ============================================================

if [ ! -d "$DESTINATION" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Archived session cannot be found after copying."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Archived session exists."


# ============================================================
# 02G — VERIFY ARCHIVE CONTAINS EXPECTED HTML
# ============================================================

ARCHIVE_HTML_COUNT=0


for ITEM in "$DESTINATION"/*.html "$DESTINATION"/*.htm; do

    [ -f "$ITEM" ] || continue

    ARCHIVE_HTML_COUNT=$((ARCHIVE_HTML_COUNT + 1))

done


if [ "$ARCHIVE_HTML_COUNT" -ne 1 ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Archive does not contain exactly one HTML file."
    echo "       Found: $ARCHIVE_HTML_COUNT"
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Archived HTML verified."


# ============================================================
# 02H — VERIFY ARCHIVE *_files FOLDER
# ============================================================

ARCHIVE_FILES_COUNT=0


for ITEM in "$DESTINATION"/*_files; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    ARCHIVE_FILES_COUNT=$((ARCHIVE_FILES_COUNT + 1))

done


if [ "$ARCHIVE_FILES_COUNT" -ne 1 ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Archive does not contain exactly one *_files folder."
    echo "       Found: $ARCHIVE_FILES_COUNT"
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Archived *_files folder verified."


# ============================================================
# 02I — SUCCESS
# ============================================================

echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "[SUCCESS] SESSION ARCHIVED"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "Session:"
echo "  $SESSION_NAME"
echo
echo "Temporary archive:"
echo "  $DESTINATION"
echo
echo "The original remains safely on the thumb drive."
echo
echo "The Hub may proceed to Routine 03."
echo "============================================================"


# ============================================================
# RETURN SUCCESS TO HUB
# ============================================================

exit 0

    The important thing here is the empty-archive gate:

    Routine 01
   ↓
ONE session identified
   ↓
Routine 02
   ↓
Is temporary archive empty?
   ├── NO → STOP
   └── YES
        ↓
   Copy this exact session
        ↓
   Verify copy
        ↓
   SUCCESS

    So an old archive can no longer quietly interfere with the current session. If you forget to clean it manually, the program stops and tells you why rather than guessing.

    Routine 03 — Verify Archive

    This is the second look at the archive. Routine 02 proved that the copy was created; Routine 03 now verifies that the actual contents match the original session structure.

    Routine 03 — Verify Archive
    #!/usr/bin/env bash

# ============================================================
# 03_VERIFY_ARCHIVE.sh
#
# PURPOSE:
#   Independently verify that the temporary archive contains
#   a complete copy of the ONE session identified by the Hub.
#
# INPUT:
#   SESSION_NAME
#
# THIS ROUTINE:
#   - Compares the thumb-drive session with the archive copy
#   - Verifies the original HTML file
#   - Verifies the *_files folder
#   - Compares file names
#   - Compares file sizes
#   - Compares file contents using SHA-256 checksums
#   - DOES NOT modify anything
#   - DOES NOT delete anything
#
# RETURN:
#   0 = SUCCESS
#   non-zero = FAILURE
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   This is our first true CONTENT verification.
#   We are not merely asking "does the folder exist?"
#   We are asking "is this actually the same session?"
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

THUMB_DRIVE="/d/GitHub"

TEMP_ARCHIVE="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Session_Archive"


# ============================================================
# 03A — REQUIRE SESSION NAME
# ============================================================

if [ -z "$SESSION_NAME" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] SESSION_NAME was not supplied by the Hub."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Session supplied by Hub:"
echo "     $SESSION_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 03B — DEFINE SOURCE AND ARCHIVE
# ============================================================

SOURCE_SESSION="$THUMB_DRIVE/$SESSION_NAME"

ARCHIVE_SESSION="$TEMP_ARCHIVE/$SESSION_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 03C — VERIFY BOTH LOCATIONS EXIST
# ============================================================

if [ ! -d "$SOURCE_SESSION" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Original thumb-drive session is missing."
    exit 1

fi


if [ ! -d "$ARCHIVE_SESSION" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Archived session is missing."
    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Original and archive sessions both exist."


# ============================================================
# 03D — CREATE FILE LISTS
#
# We compare every file underneath the session directory.
#
# Relative paths are used so:
#
#   original.html
#
# and
#
#   original_files/page.png
#
# can be compared directly.
# ============================================================

SOURCE_LIST="$(mktemp)"
ARCHIVE_LIST="$(mktemp)"


cleanup() {

    rm -f "$SOURCE_LIST"
    rm -f "$ARCHIVE_LIST"

}


trap cleanup EXIT


(
    cd "$SOURCE_SESSION" || exit 1
    find . -type f -print | sort
) > "$SOURCE_LIST"


if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not create original file list."
    exit 1

fi


(
    cd "$ARCHIVE_SESSION" || exit 1
    find . -type f -print | sort
) > "$ARCHIVE_LIST"


if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not create archive file list."
    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 03E — COMPARE FILE LISTS
# ============================================================

if ! diff -q "$SOURCE_LIST" "$ARCHIVE_LIST" >/dev/null 2>&1; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] ORIGINAL AND ARCHIVE FILE LISTS DIFFER."
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "The archive cannot be trusted as a complete copy."
    echo
    echo "Nothing will be deleted."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] File lists match."


# ============================================================
# 03F — VERIFY FILE COUNTS
# ============================================================

SOURCE_FILE_COUNT="$(wc -l < "$SOURCE_LIST")"
ARCHIVE_FILE_COUNT="$(wc -l < "$ARCHIVE_LIST")"


if [ "$SOURCE_FILE_COUNT" -ne "$ARCHIVE_FILE_COUNT" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] File counts differ."
    echo "       Original: $SOURCE_FILE_COUNT"
    echo "       Archive:  $ARCHIVE_FILE_COUNT"
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] File counts match:"
echo "     $SOURCE_FILE_COUNT file(s)"


# ============================================================
# 03G — COMPARE SHA-256 CHECKSUMS
#
# This is the strongest local verification in this routine.
#
# Every file in the original is hashed.
# Every corresponding file in the archive is hashed.
#
# Matching names + matching SHA-256 values means the archive
# contains the same file contents.
# ============================================================

echo
echo "[WORKING] Comparing SHA-256 checksums..."
echo


while IFS= read -r RELATIVE_FILE; do

    SOURCE_FILE="$SOURCE_SESSION/${RELATIVE_FILE#./}"
    ARCHIVE_FILE="$ARCHIVE_SESSION/${RELATIVE_FILE#./}"


    if [ ! -f "$SOURCE_FILE" ]; then

        echo "[FAIL] Original file disappeared:"
        echo "       $RELATIVE_FILE"

        exit 1

    fi


    if [ ! -f "$ARCHIVE_FILE" ]; then

        echo "[FAIL] Archive file is missing:"
        echo "       $RELATIVE_FILE"

        exit 1

    fi


    SOURCE_HASH="$(sha256sum "$SOURCE_FILE" | awk '{print $1}')"

    ARCHIVE_HASH="$(sha256sum "$ARCHIVE_FILE" | awk '{print $1}')"


    if [ "$SOURCE_HASH" != "$ARCHIVE_HASH" ]; then

        echo
        echo "============================================================"
        echo "[FAIL] FILE CONTENTS DO NOT MATCH"
        echo "============================================================"
        echo
        echo "File:"
        echo "  $RELATIVE_FILE"
        echo
        echo "Original:"
        echo "  $SOURCE_HASH"
        echo
        echo "Archive:"
        echo "  $ARCHIVE_HASH"
        echo
        echo "Nothing will be deleted."
        echo "============================================================"

        exit 1

    fi

done < "$SOURCE_LIST"


echo "[OK] SHA-256 checksums match."


# ============================================================
# 03H — EXPLICITLY VERIFY ORIGINAL HTML
# ============================================================

HTML_COUNT=0


for ITEM in "$SOURCE_SESSION"/*.html "$SOURCE_SESSION"/*.htm; do

    [ -f "$ITEM" ] || continue

    HTML_COUNT=$((HTML_COUNT + 1))

done


if [ "$HTML_COUNT" -ne 1 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Original session does not contain exactly one HTML file."
    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Original HTML verified."


# ============================================================
# 03I — EXPLICITLY VERIFY *_files FOLDER
# ============================================================

FILES_COUNT=0


for ITEM in "$SOURCE_SESSION"/*_files; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    FILES_COUNT=$((FILES_COUNT + 1))

done


if [ "$FILES_COUNT" -ne 1 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Original session does not contain exactly one *_files folder."
    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Original *_files folder verified."


# ============================================================
# 03J — FINAL SUCCESS
# ============================================================

echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "[SUCCESS] ARCHIVE VERIFIED"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "Session:"
echo "  $SESSION_NAME"
echo
echo "Verified:"
echo "  [OK] File names"
echo "  [OK] File count"
echo "  [OK] File contents"
echo "  [OK] Original HTML"
echo "  [OK] Original *_files folder"
echo
echo "The temporary archive is a verified copy."
echo
echo "The Hub may proceed to Routine 04."
echo "============================================================"


# ============================================================
# RETURN SUCCESS TO HUB
# ============================================================

exit 0

    Routine 04 — Prepare Web

    This is the routine where we finally deal with the Edge naming problem.

    The original Edge capture stays untouched:

    Your Original Name.html
Your Original Name_files/

    The Web copy becomes:

    index.html

    The important part is that we are copying the HTML file and changing only the copy's filename. The contents of the HTML file still contain the references Edge created to the _files folder. Since the _files folder itself keeps its original name, those references remain valid.

    Routine 04 — Prepare Web
    #!/usr/bin/env bash

# ============================================================
# 04_PREPARE_WEB.sh
#
# PURPOSE:
#   Create the webpage version of the original Edge session.
#
# ORIGINAL:
#
#   Original Session Name.html
#   Original Session Name_files/
#
# WEB COPY:
#
#   index.html
#   Original Session Name_files/
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   We rename ONLY THE COPY of the HTML file.
#
#   The original HTML remains unchanged.
#   The original *_files folder remains unchanged.
#
# INPUT:
#   SESSION_NAME supplied by the Hub.
#
# SOURCE:
#   Temporary verified archive.
#
# DESTINATION:
#   Temporary Web Work directory.
#
# RETURN:
#   0 = SUCCESS
#   non-zero = FAILURE
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

TEMP_ARCHIVE="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Session_Archive"

WEB_WORK="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Web_Work"


# ============================================================
# 04A — REQUIRE SESSION NAME
# ============================================================

if [ -z "$SESSION_NAME" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] SESSION_NAME was not supplied by the Hub."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Session supplied by Hub:"
echo "     $SESSION_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 04B — DEFINE SOURCE
# ============================================================

SOURCE_SESSION="$TEMP_ARCHIVE/$SESSION_NAME"


if [ ! -d "$SOURCE_SESSION" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Verified archive session was not found."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Verified archive session found."


# ============================================================
# 04C — CREATE WEB WORK DIRECTORY
# ============================================================

if [ ! -d "$WEB_WORK" ]; then

    mkdir -p "$WEB_WORK"

    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

        echo "[FAIL] Could not create Web Work directory."
        exit 1

    fi

fi


# ============================================================
# 04D — MAKE SURE THIS SESSION DOES NOT ALREADY EXIST
# ============================================================

WEB_SESSION="$WEB_WORK/$SESSION_NAME"


if [ -e "$WEB_SESSION" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Web Work session already exists."
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "$WEB_SESSION"
    echo
    echo "Nothing will be overwritten."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 04E — CREATE WEB SESSION DIRECTORY
# ============================================================

mkdir -p "$WEB_SESSION"


if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not create Web session directory."
    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Web session directory created."


# ============================================================
# 04F — FIND ORIGINAL HTML
# ============================================================

HTML_FILE=""

HTML_COUNT=0


for ITEM in "$SOURCE_SESSION"/*.html "$SOURCE_SESSION"/*.htm; do

    [ -f "$ITEM" ] || continue

    HTML_COUNT=$((HTML_COUNT + 1))
    HTML_FILE="$ITEM"

done


if [ "$HTML_COUNT" -ne 1 ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Expected exactly one original HTML file."
    echo "       Found: $HTML_COUNT"
    echo "============================================================"

    rm -rf -- "$WEB_SESSION"

    exit 1

fi


ORIGINAL_HTML_NAME="$(basename "$HTML_FILE")"


echo "[OK] Original HTML:"
echo "     $ORIGINAL_HTML_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 04G — FIND ORIGINAL *_files FOLDER
# ============================================================

FILES_FOLDER=""

FILES_COUNT=0


for ITEM in "$SOURCE_SESSION"/*_files; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    FILES_COUNT=$((FILES_COUNT + 1))
    FILES_FOLDER="$ITEM"

done


if [ "$FILES_COUNT" -ne 1 ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Expected exactly one *_files folder."
    echo "       Found: $FILES_COUNT"
    echo "============================================================"

    rm -rf -- "$WEB_SESSION"

    exit 1

fi


FILES_NAME="$(basename "$FILES_FOLDER")"


echo "[OK] Edge companion folder:"
echo "     $FILES_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 04H — COPY HTML AS index.html
#
# THIS IS THE CRITICAL STEP.
#
# We are NOT renaming the original.
#
# We are making a new copy whose filename is index.html.
#
# The contents of the HTML file are unchanged.
# ============================================================

echo
echo "[WORKING] Creating index.html..."

cp "$HTML_FILE" "$WEB_SESSION/index.html"


if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not create index.html."

    rm -rf -- "$WEB_SESSION"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] index.html created."


# ============================================================
# 04I — COPY THE EDGE *_files FOLDER
#
# The folder retains its original name.
#
# This is important because the HTML file contains references
# to resources using the Edge-created folder name.
# ============================================================

echo "[WORKING] Copying Edge companion folder..."

cp -R "$FILES_FOLDER" "$WEB_SESSION/$FILES_NAME"


if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not copy *_files folder."

    rm -rf -- "$WEB_SESSION"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Edge companion folder copied."


# ============================================================
# 04J — VERIFY index.html
# ============================================================

if [ ! -f "$WEB_SESSION/index.html" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] index.html cannot be found."

    rm -rf -- "$WEB_SESSION"

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 04K — VERIFY *_files FOLDER
# ============================================================

if [ ! -d "$WEB_SESSION/$FILES_NAME" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] *_files folder cannot be found."

    rm -rf -- "$WEB_SESSION"

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 04L — VERIFY *_files CONTENT
# ============================================================

WEB_FILE_COUNT="$(
    find "$WEB_SESSION/$FILES_NAME" -type f | wc -l
)"


if [ "$WEB_FILE_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Web *_files folder contains no files."

    rm -rf -- "$WEB_SESSION"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Web companion folder contains:"
echo "     $WEB_FILE_COUNT file(s)"


# ============================================================
# 04M — VERIFY HTML COPY CONTENT
#
# Compare the original HTML with index.html.
#
# They should have identical contents.
# Only their filenames are different.
# ============================================================

ORIGINAL_HASH="$(
    sha256sum "$HTML_FILE" | awk '{print $1}'
)"


WEB_HASH="$(
    sha256sum "$WEB_SESSION/index.html" | awk '{print $1}'
)"


if [ "$ORIGINAL_HASH" != "$WEB_HASH" ]; then

    echo

    echo "[FAIL] index.html does not match original HTML."
    echo "============================================================"

    rm -rf -- "$WEB_SESSION"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] index.html content matches original HTML."


# ============================================================
# 04N — SUCCESS
# ============================================================

echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "[SUCCESS] WEBPAGE PREPARED"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "Original remains:"
echo "  $ORIGINAL_HTML_NAME"
echo
echo "Web copy:"
echo "  index.html"
echo
echo "Companion folder:"
echo "  $FILES_NAME"
echo
echo "The original Edge session has not been changed."
echo
echo "The Hub may proceed to Routine 05."
echo "============================================================"


# ============================================================
# RETURN SUCCESS TO HUB
# ============================================================

exit 0

    The key idea

    We're not doing this:

    Original Edge session
└── rename original.html → index.html

    We're doing this:

                     VERIFIED ARCHIVE
                       │
             ┌─────────┴─────────┐
             │                   │
             ▼                   ▼
       LIBRARY COPY         WEB WORK COPY
       untouched            ├── index.html
       original.html        └── original_files/

    So the original title is preserved in the Library, while the Web copy gets the special index.html name that GitHub Pages needs.

    And Routine 04 proves that index.html has exactly the same contents as the Edge HTML before allowing us to proceed.

    Routine 05 — Push Library
    #!/usr/bin/env bash

# ============================================================
# 05_PUSH_LIBRARY.sh
#
# PURPOSE:
#   Copy the ORIGINAL Edge session from the verified temporary
#   archive into the Library Git repository and push it to
#   GitHub.
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   The Library preserves the original Edge capture:
#
#       Original Name.html
#       Original Name_files/
#
#   It does NOT use index.html.
#
# INPUT:
#   SESSION_NAME supplied by the Hub.
#
# RETURN:
#   0 = SUCCESS
#   non-zero = FAILURE
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

TEMP_ARCHIVE="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Session_Archive"

LIBRARY_REPO="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Library"

LIBRARY_BRANCH="main"


# ============================================================
# 05A — REQUIRE SESSION NAME
# ============================================================

if [ -z "$SESSION_NAME" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] SESSION_NAME was not supplied by the Hub."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Session supplied by Hub:"
echo "     $SESSION_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 05B — VERIFY ARCHIVE SESSION
# ============================================================

SOURCE_SESSION="$TEMP_ARCHIVE/$SESSION_NAME"


if [ ! -d "$SOURCE_SESSION" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Archived session was not found."
    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Archived session found."


# ============================================================
# 05C — VERIFY LIBRARY REPOSITORY
# ============================================================

if [ ! -d "$LIBRARY_REPO/.git" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Library repository was not found."
    exit 1

fi


cd "$LIBRARY_REPO" || {

    echo "[FAIL] Could not enter Library repository."

    This routine is deliberately independent of the previous push routine. We don't simply trust that git push said success.

    Routine 06 — Verify Library
    #!/usr/bin/env bash

# ============================================================
# 06_VERIFY_LIBRARY.sh
#
# PURPOSE:
#   Independently verify that the Library repository on GitHub
#   actually contains the session that Routine 05 attempted
#   to upload.
#
# INPUT:
#   SESSION_NAME supplied by the Hub.
#
# THIS ROUTINE:
#   - Contacts the remote GitHub repository
#   - Confirms the current branch is synchronized
#   - Confirms the session directory exists in the local
#     repository after the push
#   - Confirms the original HTML file exists
#   - Confirms the *_files folder exists
#   - Compares the GitHub-tracked commit with the local commit
#   - DOES NOT modify anything
#   - DOES NOT delete anything
#
# RETURN:
#   0 = SUCCESS
#   non-zero = FAILURE
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   This routine verifies the Git transaction itself.
#   Later routines will verify the actual remote webpage/API
#   as an additional independent check.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

LIBRARY_REPO="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Library"

LIBRARY_BRANCH="main"


# ============================================================
# 06A — REQUIRE SESSION NAME
# ============================================================

if [ -z "$SESSION_NAME" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] SESSION_NAME was not supplied by the Hub."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Session supplied by Hub:"
echo "     $SESSION_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 06B — VERIFY LIBRARY REPOSITORY
# ============================================================

if [ ! -d "$LIBRARY_REPO/.git" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Library Git repository was not found."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


cd "$LIBRARY_REPO" || {

    echo "[FAIL] Could not enter Library repository."
    exit 1

}


echo "[OK] Library repository found."


# ============================================================
# 06C — VERIFY SESSION DIRECTORY
# ============================================================

LIBRARY_SESSION="$LIBRARY_REPO/$SESSION_NAME"


if [ ! -d "$LIBRARY_SESSION" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Library session is not present."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Library session exists."


# ============================================================
# 06D — VERIFY ORIGINAL HTML
# ============================================================

HTML_COUNT=0
HTML_FILE=""


for ITEM in "$LIBRARY_SESSION"/*.html "$LIBRARY_SESSION"/*.htm; do

    [ -f "$ITEM" ] || continue

    HTML_COUNT=$((HTML_COUNT + 1))
    HTML_FILE="$ITEM"

done


if [ "$HTML_COUNT" -ne 1 ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Library session does not contain exactly one HTML file."
    echo "       Found: $HTML_COUNT"
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Original HTML exists:"
echo "     $(basename "$HTML_FILE")"


# ============================================================
# 06E — VERIFY *_files FOLDER
# ============================================================

FILES_COUNT=0
FILES_FOLDER=""


for ITEM in "$LIBRARY_SESSION"/*_files; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    FILES_COUNT=$((FILES_COUNT + 1))
    FILES_FOLDER="$ITEM"

done


if [ "$FILES_COUNT" -ne 1 ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Library session does not contain exactly one *_files"
    echo "       folder."
    echo "       Found: $FILES_COUNT"
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Original *_files folder exists:"
echo "     $(basename "$FILES_FOLDER")"


# ============================================================
# 06F — VERIFY GIT WORKTREE
#
# There should be no uncommitted changes at this point.
# ============================================================

if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Library repository has uncommitted changes."
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "The repository is not in the expected clean state."
    echo "Nothing will be deleted."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Library working tree is clean."


# ============================================================
# 06G — CONTACT GITHUB
#
# Fetch the remote branch information.
#
# This does not change the working files.
# ============================================================

echo
echo "[WORKING] Checking remote GitHub repository..."

git fetch origin "$LIBRARY_BRANCH"


if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Could not contact the Library GitHub repository."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] GitHub remote contacted."


# ============================================================
# 06H — VERIFY LOCAL AND REMOTE COMMITS MATCH
# ============================================================

LOCAL_COMMIT="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"

REMOTE_COMMIT="$(
    git rev-parse "origin/$LIBRARY_BRANCH"
)"


if [ "$LOCAL_COMMIT" != "$REMOTE_COMMIT" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Local and GitHub Library commits do not match."
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "Local:"
    echo "  $LOCAL_COMMIT"
    echo
    echo "GitHub:"
    echo "  $REMOTE_COMMIT"
    echo
    echo "The upload cannot yet be declared verified."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Local and GitHub commits match."


# ============================================================
# 06I — VERIFY SESSION IS TRACKED BY GIT
# ============================================================

if ! git ls-files --error-unmatch "$SESSION_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Git does not recognize the session as tracked content."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Session is tracked by Git."


# ============================================================
# 06J — FINAL SUCCESS
# ============================================================

echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "[SUCCESS] LIBRARY VERIFIED"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "Session:"
echo "  $SESSION_NAME"
echo
echo "Verified:"
echo "  [OK] Library session exists"
echo "  [OK] Original HTML exists"
echo "  [OK] *_files folder exists"
echo "  [OK] Working tree is clean"
echo "  [OK] GitHub remote was contacted"
echo "  [OK] Local and remote commits match"
echo "  [OK] Session is tracked by Git"
echo
echo "The Library copy is verified."
echo
echo "The Hub may proceed to Routine 07."
echo "============================================================"


# ============================================================
# RETURN SUCCESS TO HUB
# ============================================================

exit 0
