    This is an important distinction: Routine 08 proved the files are in the Web repository. Routine 09 proves that a browser can actually retrieve the resulting GitHub Pages page.

    Because we haven't yet finalized the actual GitHub account/repository names, this routine will have one configuration value for the GitHub Pages base URL. We will fill that in when we configure the repository.

    Routine 09 — Verify Actual Webpage
    #!/usr/bin/env bash

# ============================================================
# 09_VERIFY_WEBPAGE.sh
#
# PURPOSE:
#   Verify that GitHub Pages is actually serving the webpage
#   that Routine 08 verified inside the Web repository.
#
# INPUT:
#   SESSION_NAME supplied by the Hub.
#
# CONFIGURATION:
#   GITHUB_PAGES_BASE_URL
#
# EXAMPLE:
#
#   https://YOUR-ACCOUNT.github.io/YOUR-REPOSITORY
#
# The actual value will be established when the GitHub Pages
# repository is configured.
#
# THIS ROUTINE:
#   - Builds the expected webpage URL
#   - Contacts the URL
#   - Allows time for GitHub Pages to publish
#   - Retries if publication is still in progress
#   - Confirms an HTTP success response
#   - Confirms that index.html produced actual page content
#   - DOES NOT modify anything
#   - DOES NOT delete anything
#
# RETURN:
#   0 = SUCCESS
#   non-zero = FAILURE
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

GITHUB_PAGES_BASE_URL="REPLACE-WITH-ACTUAL-GITHUB-PAGES-URL"

MAX_ATTEMPTS=12

WAIT_SECONDS=10


# ============================================================
# 09A — REQUIRE SESSION NAME
# ============================================================

if [ -z "$SESSION_NAME" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] SESSION_NAME was not supplied by the Hub."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Session supplied by Hub:"
echo "     $SESSION_NAME"


# ============================================================
# 09B — VERIFY PAGES URL HAS BEEN CONFIGURED
# ============================================================

if [ "$GITHUB_PAGES_BASE_URL" = \
     "REPLACE-WITH-ACTUAL-GITHUB-PAGES-URL" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] GitHub Pages URL has not yet been configured."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 09C — CONSTRUCT SESSION WEBPAGE URL
#
# The session directory is part of the published URL.
#
# Example:
#
#   base/
#       Episode-01/
#           index.html
#
# becomes:
#
#   base/Episode-01/
#
# ============================================================

SESSION_URL="${GITHUB_PAGES_BASE_URL%/}/$SESSION_NAME/"


echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "GITHUB PAGES VERIFICATION"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "Testing:"
echo "  $SESSION_URL"
echo


# ============================================================
# 09D — TRY THE PAGE
#
# GitHub Pages may need a short amount of time after the Git
# push before the new page is available.
#
# Therefore a temporary HTTP failure does not immediately
# constitute a system failure.
# ============================================================

ATTEMPT=1

PAGE_VERIFIED=0


while [ "$ATTEMPT" -le "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do

    echo "[WORKING] Page check $ATTEMPT of $MAX_ATTEMPTS..."


    HTTP_STATUS="$(
        curl \
            --silent \
            --show-error \
            --location \
            --output /tmp/github_pages_response.html \
            --write-out "%{http_code}" \
            "$SESSION_URL" \
            2>/dev/null
    )"


    CURL_STATUS=$?


    # ========================================================
    # 09E — VERIFY CURL COMPLETED
    # ========================================================

    if [ "$CURL_STATUS" -eq 0 ]; then

        echo "[OK] Web server responded."


        # ====================================================
        # 09F — VERIFY HTTP SUCCESS
        # ====================================================

        if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" = "200" ]; then

            echo "[OK] HTTP status: 200"


            # ================================================
            # 09G — VERIFY PAGE CONTAINS HTML
            # ================================================

            if grep -qi "<html\|<!doctype html" \
                /tmp/github_pages_response.html; then

                PAGE_VERIFIED=1

                break

            else

                echo "[WAIT] Server responded, but expected HTML"
                echo "       content was not detected."

            fi

        else

            echo "[WAIT] HTTP status: $HTTP_STATUS"

        fi

    else

        echo "[WAIT] Page is not yet reachable."

    fi


    # ========================================================
    # 09H — RETRY DELAY
    # ========================================================

    if [ "$ATTEMPT" -lt "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then

        echo "[WAIT] Waiting $WAIT_SECONDS seconds..."
        sleep "$WAIT_SECONDS"

    fi


    ATTEMPT=$((ATTEMPT + 1))

done


# ============================================================
# 09I — REMOVE TEMPORARY RESPONSE
# ============================================================

rm -f /tmp/github_pages_response.html


# ============================================================
# 09J — DETERMINE RESULT
# ============================================================

if [ "$PAGE_VERIFIED" -ne 1 ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] GitHub Pages could not be verified."
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "The Web repository itself was previously verified."
    echo
    echo "Therefore the Hub will STOP."
    echo
    echo "The session remains safely:"
    echo "  - on the thumb drive"
    echo "  - in the temporary archive"
    echo "  - in the Library"
    echo "  - in the Web repository"
    echo
    echo "Nothing will be deleted."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 09K — SUCCESS
# ============================================================

echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "[SUCCESS] WEBPAGE VERIFIED"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "Session:"
echo "  $SESSION_NAME"
echo
echo "Published page:"
echo "  $SESSION_URL"
echo
echo "A browser-accessible HTML page was successfully retrieved."
echo
echo "The Hub may proceed to Routine 10."
echo "============================================================"


# ============================================================
# RETURN SUCCESS TO HUB
# ============================================================

exit 0

08  VERIFY WEB FILES

09  VERIFY WEBPAGE
       ↓
    "A browser can actually reach it."

    Routine 10 — Create Library Link
    #!/usr/bin/env bash

# ============================================================
# 10_CREATE_LIBRARY_LINK.sh
#
# PURPOSE:
#   Create the Library's navigation link to the verified
#   GitHub Pages version of the session.
#
# INPUT:
#   SESSION_NAME
#   PAGE_URL
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   The original Edge HTML and *_files folder are NEVER edited.
#
#   The link is stored in a separate navigation file:
#
#       READ_EPISODE.html
#
# inside the session's Library directory.
#
# This lets a person browsing the Library see a clear link:
#
#       READ EPISODE
#
# and click it to open the published webpage.
#
# RETURN:
#   0 = SUCCESS
#   non-zero = FAILURE
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

LIBRARY_REPO="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Library"

LIBRARY_BRANCH="main"


# ============================================================
# 10A — REQUIRE SESSION NAME
# ============================================================

if [ -z "$SESSION_NAME" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] SESSION_NAME was not supplied by the Hub."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 10B — REQUIRE PAGE URL
#
# Routine 09 is expected to supply the verified URL.
# ============================================================

if [ -z "$PAGE_URL" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Verified PAGE_URL was not supplied by the Hub."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Session:"
echo "     $SESSION_NAME"

echo "[OK] Verified webpage:"
echo "     $PAGE_URL"


# ============================================================
# 10C — DEFINE LIBRARY SESSION
# ============================================================

LIBRARY_SESSION="$LIBRARY_REPO/$SESSION_NAME"


if [ ! -d "$LIBRARY_SESSION" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Library session does not exist."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 10D — DEFINE NAVIGATION FILE
# ============================================================

LINK_FILE="$LIBRARY_SESSION/READ_EPISODE.html"


# ============================================================
# 10E — PREVENT OVERWRITE
# ============================================================

if [ -e "$LINK_FILE" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] READ_EPISODE.html already exists."
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "Nothing will be overwritten."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 10F — CREATE NAVIGATION PAGE
#
# This is intentionally a tiny HTML document.
#
# The original Edge capture remains untouched.
# ============================================================

cat > "$LINK_FILE" <<EOF
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Read Episode</title>
</head>

<body>

<h1>Read Episode</h1>

<p>
<a href="$PAGE_URL">
Open the published webpage
</a>
</p>

</body>
</html>
EOF


if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not create READ_EPISODE.html."
    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 10G — VERIFY LINK FILE
# ============================================================

if [ ! -f "$LINK_FILE" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] READ_EPISODE.html was not created."
    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 10H — VERIFY PAGE URL IS PRESENT
# ============================================================

if ! grep -Fq "$PAGE_URL" "$LINK_FILE"; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Verified webpage URL was not found in link file."
    echo "============================================================"

    rm -f -- "$LINK_FILE"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Navigation link created."


# ============================================================
# 10I — STAGE NAVIGATION FILE
# ============================================================

cd "$LIBRARY_REPO" || {

    echo "[FAIL] Could not enter Library repository."
    exit 1

}


git add -- "$SESSION_NAME/READ_EPISODE.html"


if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Could not stage Library navigation file."
    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 10J — COMMIT
# ============================================================

COMMIT_MESSAGE="Add webpage link for $SESSION_NAME"


echo "[WORKING] Creating Library link commit..."


git commit -m "$COMMIT_MESSAGE"


if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Library link commit failed."
    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Library link committed."


# ============================================================
# 10K — PUSH LINK TO GITHUB
# ============================================================

echo "[WORKING] Pushing Library link to GitHub..."


git push origin "$LIBRARY_BRANCH"


if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Library link push failed."
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "Nothing will be deleted."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 10L — SUCCESS
# ============================================================

echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "[SUCCESS] LIBRARY LINK CREATED"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "Session:"
echo "  $SESSION_NAME"
echo
echo "Navigation file:"
echo "  READ_EPISODE.html"
echo
echo "Verified destination:"
echo "  $PAGE_URL"
echo
echo "The Hub may proceed to Routine 11."
echo "============================================================"


# ============================================================
# RETURN SUCCESS TO HUB
# ============================================================

exit 0

    Routine 12 — Clean Temporary Archive
    #!/usr/bin/env bash

# ============================================================
# 12_CLEAN_ARCHIVE.sh
#
# PURPOSE:
#   Remove the successfully processed session from the
#   temporary desktop archive.
#
# IMPORTANT:
#
#   THIS IS A DESTRUCTIVE ROUTINE.
#
#   It is intentionally placed near the END of the Hub.
#
#   The session is NOT removed unless every preceding routine
#   has returned SUCCESS.
#
# INPUT:
#   SESSION_NAME supplied by the Hub.
#
# SAFETY MODEL:
#
#   Thumb Drive
#        │
#        ▼
#   Temporary Archive
#        │
#        ├── Library verified
#        ├── Web repository verified
#        ├── Webpage verified
#        └── Library link verified
#                  │
#                  ▼
#             CLEAN ARCHIVE
#
# RETURN:
#   0 = SUCCESS
#   non-zero = FAILURE
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

TEMP_ARCHIVE="$HOME/Desktop/GitHub_Session_Archive"


# ============================================================
# 12A — REQUIRE SESSION NAME
# ============================================================

if [ -z "$SESSION_NAME" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] SESSION_NAME was not supplied by the Hub."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "ARCHIVE CLEANUP"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "Session:"
echo "  $SESSION_NAME"
echo


# ============================================================
# 12B — VERIFY ARCHIVE EXISTS
# ============================================================

if [ ! -d "$TEMP_ARCHIVE" ]; then

    echo "[FAIL] Temporary archive does not exist."

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Temporary archive found."


# ============================================================
# 12C — LOCATE SESSION
# ============================================================

ARCHIVE_SESSION="$TEMP_ARCHIVE/$SESSION_NAME"


if [ ! -d "$ARCHIVE_SESSION" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Session is not present in temporary archive."
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "Nothing will be deleted."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Archived session found."


# ============================================================
# 12D — SHOW WHAT WILL BE REMOVED
#
# This gives the operator a visible checkpoint in Git Bash.
# ============================================================

echo
echo "The following temporary archive session is ready for"
echo "removal:"
echo

echo "  $ARCHIVE_SESSION"

echo


# ============================================================
# 12E — VERIFY ARCHIVE SESSION IS NOT EMPTY
# ============================================================

if [ -z "$(find "$ARCHIVE_SESSION" -mindepth 1 -print -quit)" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Archive session is unexpectedly empty."
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "Nothing will be deleted."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Archive session contains data."


# ============================================================
# 12F — REMOVE PROCESSED SESSION
#
# At this point the Hub has already received SUCCESS from:
#
#   Routine 06 — Library verification
#   Routine 08 — Web file verification
#   Routine 09 — Webpage verification
#   Routine 11 — Library link verification
#
# Therefore this copy is now the disposable temporary copy.
# ============================================================

echo
echo "[WORKING] Removing processed session from archive..."


rm -rf -- "$ARCHIVE_SESSION"


if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Archive cleanup failed."
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "The session was NOT confirmed as removed."
    echo "The Hub will stop."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 12G — VERIFY REMOVAL
# ============================================================

if [ -e "$ARCHIVE_SESSION" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Archive session still exists."
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "Cleanup cannot be declared successful."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Archived session removed."


# ============================================================
# 12H — COUNT REMAINING ARCHIVE SESSIONS
#
# This is the important "counter" feature.
#
# Zero means:
#
#   "No session remains waiting to be processed."
#
# ============================================================

REMAINING_COUNT=0


for ITEM in "$TEMP_ARCHIVE"/*; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    REMAINING_COUNT=$((REMAINING_COUNT + 1))

done


# ============================================================
# 12I — REPORT COUNTER
# ============================================================

echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "TEMPORARY ARCHIVE STATUS"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "Remaining archived sessions:"
echo "  $REMAINING_COUNT"
echo


# ============================================================
# 12J — SUCCESS
# ============================================================

if [ "$REMAINING_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then

    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[SUCCESS] ARCHIVE IS EMPTY"
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "The temporary archive now says through its state:"
    echo
    echo "  ONE SESSION RECEIVED"
    echo "  ONE SESSION PROCESSED"
    echo "  ZERO SESSIONS REMAIN"
    echo
    echo "The temporary archive is clean."
    echo
    echo "The Hub may proceed to Routine 13."
    echo "============================================================"

else

    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[SUCCESS] SESSION CLEANED"
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "Remaining sessions in archive:"
    echo "  $REMAINING_COUNT"
    echo
    echo "The processed session was removed successfully."
    echo
    echo "The Hub may proceed to Routine 13."
    echo "============================================================"

fi


# ============================================================
# RETURN SUCCESS TO HUB
# ============================================================

exit 0

# ============================================================

THUMB_SESSION="$THUMB_DRIVE/$SESSION_NAME"


if [ ! -d "$THUMB_SESSION" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Expected session was not found on thumb drive."
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "Nothing will be deleted."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Expected session found."


# ============================================================
# 13D — SAFETY CHECK
#
# Make absolutely certain that the path we are about to
# remove is actually BELOW the configured thumb-drive folder.
#
# This prevents a bad SESSION_NAME from becoming a dangerous
# filesystem command.
# ============================================================

case "$THUMB_SESSION" in

    "$THUMB_DRIVE"/*)
        ;;
    *)
        echo
        echo "============================================================"
        echo "[FAIL] Safety check rejected deletion path."
        echo "============================================================"

        exit 1
        ;;

esac


# ============================================================
# 13E — SHOW FINAL DELETION
# ============================================================

echo
echo "The successfully processed session is:"
echo
echo "  $THUMB_SESSION"
echo
echo "It is now being removed from the thumb drive."
echo


# ============================================================
# 13F — REMOVE SESSION
# ============================================================

rm -rf -- "$THUMB_SESSION"


if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Could not remove session from thumb drive."
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "The GitHub processing itself was successful."
    echo
    echo "The session remains on the thumb drive."
    echo "It should NOT be manually uploaded again until this"
    echo "condition is investigated."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Session removed from thumb drive."


# ============================================================
# 13G — VERIFY SESSION IS REALLY GONE
# ============================================================

if [ -e "$THUMB_SESSION" ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] Session still exists on thumb drive."
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "The thumb drive cannot be declared clean."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


echo "[OK] Processed session no longer exists."


# ============================================================
# 13H — COUNT REMAINING SESSION FOLDERS
#
# For our one-session-at-a-time design:
#
#       0 = MISSION ACCOMPLISHED
#       1+ = SOMETHING REMAINS
#
# This also gives us a foundation for future batch processing.
# ============================================================

REMAINING_COUNT=0


for ITEM in "$THUMB_DRIVE"/*; do

    [ -d "$ITEM" ] || continue

    REMAINING_COUNT=$((REMAINING_COUNT + 1))

done


# ============================================================
# 13I — FINAL RESULT
# ============================================================

if [ "$REMAINING_COUNT" -ne 0 ]; then

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[FAIL] THUMB DRIVE IS NOT EMPTY"
    echo "============================================================"
    echo
    echo "Remaining session folders:"
    echo "  $REMAINING_COUNT"
    echo
    echo "The processed session was successfully removed, but"
    echo "something else remains on the thumb drive."
    echo
    echo "The Hub will STOP."
    echo "============================================================"

    exit 1

fi


# ============================================================
# 13J — FINAL MISSION ACCOMPLISHED
# ============================================================

echo
echo
echo "************************************************************"
echo
echo "                 MISSION ACCOMPLISHED"
echo
echo "************************************************************"
echo
echo "Session:"
echo "  $SESSION_NAME"
echo
echo "Verified:"
echo "  [OK] Original session archived"
echo "  [OK] Original session preserved in Library"
echo "  [OK] Library upload verified"
echo "  [OK] Web files uploaded"
echo "  [OK] Web files verified"
echo "  [OK] GitHub Pages webpage verified"
echo "  [OK] Library webpage link created"
echo "  [OK] Library link verified"
echo "  [OK] Temporary archive cleaned"
echo "  [OK] Thumb drive cleaned"
echo
echo "Thumb drive remaining sessions:"
echo "  0"
echo
echo "************************************************************"
echo
echo "             READY FOR THE NEXT SESSION"
echo
echo "************************************************************"
echo


# ============================================================
# RETURN FINAL SUCCESS TO HUB
# ============================================================

exit 0

★ MISSION ACCOMPLISHED ★

    Yes. Since you're preserving this session as part of the project history, I would make one architectural observation.

    Your method is already strong. I would improve it by making every routine obey the same five-part contract:

    1. INPUT — What does this routine receive?

    2. PRECHECK — What must be true before it starts?

    3. ACTION — What exactly does it do?

    4. VERIFY — How does it prove that it worked?

    5. RETURN — 0 = success; anything else = failure.

    That gives the programmer a predictable mental template. You don't have to understand the entire program to troubleshoot Routine 08, for example. You can open Routine 08 and immediately know where to look.

    I would also add one rule to the Hub:

    The Hub never performs the work. The Hub only controls the work.

    So the Hub becomes almost ridiculously simple:

    START
  ↓
CALL 01
  ↓
IF FAILURE → STOP
  ↓
CALL 02
  ↓
IF FAILURE → STOP
  ↓
CALL 03
  ↓
IF FAILURE → STOP
  ↓
...
  ↓
CALL 13
  ↓
IF FAILURE → STOP
  ↓
END

    That separation is valuable because the controller doesn't need to know how a routine works. It only needs to know:

    "Call it. Did it succeed?"

    There's one other improvement I would recommend for programmers: give every routine a single responsibility and resist the temptation to make a routine "helpful" by doing somebody else's job.

    For example:

    • Routine 09 verifies the webpage.

    • It doesn't clean the archive.

    • It doesn't update the Library.

    • It doesn't fix a failed webpage.

    • It reports the problem and returns failure.

    That creates a very clean diagnostic trail.

    The larger idea

    What you've actually designed is almost a pipeline with checkpoints:

             ┌─────────────┐
         │   ROUTINE   │
         └──────┬──────┘
                ↓
             ACTION
                ↓
            VERIFY IT
                ↓
       ┌────────┴────────┐
       │                 │
    SUCCESS           FAILURE
       │                 │
       ↓                 ↓
    NEXT ROUTINE       STOP

    And I think that's the part worth preserving in this session for the open-source version.

    It isn't merely "a Bash program for uploading ChatGPT sessions." It is a programming architecture that makes the program readable, testable, replaceable, and troubleshootable.

    One final thought: don't make the routines clever. Make them boring.

    That's a compliment.

    A programmer opening Routine 07 six months from now should be able to understand what it does in about thirty seconds. If it takes twenty minutes to understand, we've violated the philosophy.

    That may be the best modernization of the structured-programming lesson you learned in 1981:

    Make the computer do the complicated work, but make the program itself easy for a human being to understand.
